name: fconline-event-rewards
description: Collect and verify FC Online official web-event, web-shop, and membership rewards, including event-only coin minigames.

interface.shortDescription: Check event status and collect eligible web rewards.
interface.longDescription: Refresh FC Online event progress, research quiz and visit missions, collect eligible website rewards, and process event-only coin minigames. Uses the browser and web search tools available in the host; it does not provide Nexon authentication.
defaultPrompt: Use $fconline-event-rewards to refresh event progress and collect eligible FC Online web rewards.
